claims.text: From shrinking European cities to Africa's rapidly expanding urban centers, see how fast city populations are growing worldwide.
Moldova's urban population shrinks by 1.3% a year, while Rwanda's grows by 5.6%.
Urban growth is slower in major economies: USA has 0.6%, and UK has 0.4%.
Africa dominates the fastest growth: Chad has 5.7%, Rwanda has 5.6%, and Niger has 5%.
